notes.title: Patch-1.0.1 - Score Bug Fix
notes.content: A patch to fix a bug that was causing the game to skip some levels and not allowing players to update their scores.

notes.title: LEFTY Weekly Social Media Highlights
notes.content:
LEFTY Demo is OUT NOW! 

Last week marked the launch of our LEFTY Demo! This is your opportunity to play 5 of the game's opening levels ahead of launch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114271/3c9d5522a57908d89bbf22561cfaebf13de6cee4.png

Played already? Please send in your Demo Feedback: https://forms.gle/HdkQYqBSAy2BYPAh9

 LoveEngineFive shared a LEFTY Showcase!

YouTuber LoveEngineFive posted a wholesome vid of her experience with the LEFTY Demo. 

[previewyoutube=BKJuavi95gs;full][/previewyoutube]

We LOVED seeing her perspective - and we will absolutely take her feedback into account. 

Are you a Creator? Get in touch - we’d love to set you up with codes to play the full game ahead of launch!

🙌 We revealed some footage of LEFTY’s later levels!

LEFTY’s about shifting your perspective, so we showed some footage of the increasing complexity of our game’s puzzles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114271/f57b243abcfdd65e8437473d3507eefbfe61712a.gif

Do you think you’ll be able to beat later levels? 

Join Our Cozy LEFTY Communities:

We’re looking for fellow cozy gamers in the following spaces: 

[olist]
 Discord
 X (Twitter)
 TikTok
 Facebook
 Instagram
[/olist]
